definitions.short: Er , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H6147. Er עֵר proper name, masculine Ηρ (compare עוּר Qal Participle); — 1 eldest son of Judah Gen 38:3 , 6 = 1Chr 2:3 (twice in verse), Gen 38:7 ; 46:12 (twice in verse); Num 26:19 (twice in verse) 2 son of Judah's son Shelah 1Chr 4:21 . — See also Qal Participle עֵר above

occurrences.englishText: She conceived, and bore a son; and he named him Er.
Judah took a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.
Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in Yahweh’s sight. So Yahweh killed him.
The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.
